title: Let an operator resolve a closed meeting synthesis review and read the durable result

incident.stored_synthesis: Synthesis empty or unreadable; recorded as REVIEW with no proposal.

operator_review_shape.cause: string ('unknown' on legacy rows without stored cause; specific stored cause when present)

human_inbox_projection.pending_before_review: meeting_review:{meeting_id} projected in GET /bff/management/human-inbox with status='pending', gate='meeting_review', can_proceed=false, evidence_refs, and unreadable_reason/cause context
human_inbox_projection.after_review: meeting_review:{meeting_id} leaves the pending GET /bff/management/human-inbox queue while GET /bff/management/meetings/{meeting_id} and GET /bff/meetings/{meeting_id} return operator_review.status='reviewed' and preserve outcome='REVIEW', synthesis, transcript/rounds, and proposals=[]

concurrency_and_idempotency.identical_retry: HTTP 200 with identical operator_review and replayed=true (zero duplicate lifecycle/audit/outbox writes)

runtime_storage_budget.cadence: On-demand authenticated operator action only. At hosted scale (3 enrolled trading personas, <= 3 meetings/persona/ISO week = <= 9 meetings/week total), at most 1 non-replayed review write can occur per closed REVIEW meeting.
runtime_storage_budget.count_cap: At most 1 persisted operator_review state transition, 1 ConsultAuditEvent (action='meeting_review_recorded'), and 1 ConsultOutboxRecord (topic='consult.meeting.updated') per closed REVIEW meeting. Identical retries short-circuit as replayed=true without calling put_meeting or append_audit; conflicting writes are rejected by both record_meeting_operator_review and ConsultationStore._validate_meeting_operator_review_write.
runtime_storage_budget.growth_per_day_at_hosted_scale: With 3 enrolled trading personas (<= 9 meetings/week, ~1.3 meetings/day), even if 100% of meetings closed with outcome=REVIEW, operator review writes add <= 1.3 lifecycle snapshot updates (<= 4 KB delta each), <= 1.3 audit rows (~400 B each), and <= 1.3 outbox rows (~2 KB each), totaling < 10 KB/day across existing JSONL/Postgres stores.
runtime_storage_budget.retention_and_cleanup: Persisted in-place on the existing meeting lifecycle record in consult_lifecycle_events.jsonl / consult_svc.lifecycle_events and audited in consult_audit.jsonl / consult_svc.audit_events. Outbox notifications in consult_outbox.jsonl / consult_svc.outbox_records are drained by the existing outbox publisher; duplicate no-op put_meeting writes are suppressed in ConsultationStore.put_meeting.

acceptance_probes_and_tests.read_only_probe_guarantee: Uses GET-only viewer endpoints (/bff/management/meetings, /bff/management/meetings/{id}, /bff/meetings/{id}, /bff/management/human-inbox) and never sends POST /review or mutates the user's real meeting mtg-2c016da5651a0dc4.
